data.name: Cooking Stories: Fun Cafe Game
data.detailed_description:
Play Cooking Stories — the most mouthwatering casual time-management game! Run your own café, upgrade, decorate, and conquer the culinary world!

In this cooking simulator, you’ll step into the shoes of a rising star — a producer of a cooking show. 🎥 Get ready for exciting culinary adventures as you manage your very own café and restaurant. 🍴 Embark on a delicious journey where you can upgrade and renovate your venues, decorate them to perfection, and help your star chef shine in the kitchen.

As you progress, you’ll watch your café and restaurant story unfold. New venues will open, each with its own unique features and challenges. Dive into your culinary diary and help your chef create mouthwatering dishes that keep customers coming back for more.

But that’s not all! In Cooking Stories, you’ll also explore the world of time management and culinary art. Organize your kitchen, manage your staff, and make sure every order is executed with care and precision. 👨‍🍳 And don’t forget to have fun: try your hand at interior design and upgrade your star’s home! 💄🛋

Cooking Stories is a cooking game that will captivate you for hours. Immerse yourself in the cooking story and become the master of the most successful café and restaurant in town. 🍳

Key Features:

  • Manage and upgrade your café and restaurant

  • Renovate and decorate your venues

  • Discover new stars and help them shine in the kitchen

  • Explore the world of time management and cooking skills

  • Customize your star’s home and enjoy exciting makeovers

  • Offline gameplay for your convenience

  • Engaging choice-based mechanics

So, what are you waiting for? Download Cooking Stories now and start your delicious adventure! Become the master of your café and cooking simulator. Let’s get cooking! 🔥

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8 x64
  • Processor: Intel i5 gen 2 or AMD Bulldozer (4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 6GB or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
